description: Evaluating a substituted formula equals evaluating the source formula under the source-atom valuation obtained by evaluating each replacement formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval_subst.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
  (σ : α → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula β)
  (w : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation β)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval w (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.subst σ A) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval (fun a => Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval w (σ a)) A
